name: tester
command: npm run activity-assets && npm run check && npm run pack

name: version-skew
command: docker-compose -p amocrm-final-audit-test --profile tests -f docker-compose.activity.yml -f docker-compose.activity-tests.yml run --rm --no-deps -e COMPONENT_PROCESS_PREVIOUS_API_BINARY=/src/tmp/activity-v0-evidence/pre-audit-api --entrypoint go component-tests test -race -count=1 -v -run ^TestComponentProcessesAndModeSwitch$ ./internal/componentruntime

name: final-presentation
command: docker-compose -p amocrm-final-audit-test --profile tests -f docker-compose.activity.yml -f docker-compose.activity-tests.yml run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint go component-tests test -race -p 1 -count=1 -v -run 'TestBudgetCard|TestEnumCard|TestEventCard|TestFinalAuditOwnerRPCPublicCards' ./internal/services/activity ./internal/servicerpc
